scanNote:
7-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (53-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Profiles' va KO'K yorliqda oq '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
25) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya ro'yxat: train local people, treat patients, medical equipment, improve conditions, feel useful, health care, good career, business success, retire, continue to grow, normal personal life, start a business, huge amounts of money, wealth, mixed feelings.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
26) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and tick the words which end with the sound /ɪd/. Listen again and repeat.' Uch ustunda katakchali so'zlar (qo'shimcha qalin): liked, wanted, treated | lived, worked, helped | decided, succeeded, walked.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' va qavsda '(a profile of a famous person)'.
• TO'Q SARIQ ChIZIQLI QUTI: 'When we write A PROFILE OF A FAMOUS PERSON we usually divide it into four paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we write WHO THE PERSON IS and WHY HE/SHE IS IMPORTANT. In the SECOND PARAGRAPH, we write about THE PERSON'S EARLY LIFE (i.e. when and where he/she was born, his/her childhood, the school he/she attended, etc.). In the THIRD PARAGRAPH, we write about THE PERSON'S LATER LIFE, (i.e. his/her career and important events in his/her life, in chronological order). In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we write about THE PERSON'S CHARACTER, LIKES and PLANS.'

O'NG USTUN:
28) 'Your teacher has asked you to write a profile of a famous sportsperson for the school magazine. Use the plan below, the information in Ex. 27, and the picture in the Photo File section, to write a profile of Martina Hingis (120 - 180 words). Use the text in Ex. 22 as a model.'
   DAFTAR SURATI: Pushti 'Plan'. 'Introduction' - Para 1: introduce the person. 'Main Body' - Para 2: early life; Para 3: later life. 'Conclusion' - Para 4: character, likes, plans.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom'. 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' To'q sariq chiziqli quti: • Experience is the best teacher. • Every man is the architect of his own fortune.

PASTKI QISM (binafsha fon, tennis raketkasi va to'plar):
27) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and complete the notes, then talk about Martina.' TO'RT QAYD (tennis to'pi belgili A-D, sarg'ish gap pufakchalarida):
   A Introduction: • Martina Hingis • one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis
   B Early Life: • born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia, on 30th September, ......... • started playing tennis at the age of three • parents divorced, her mother remarried in ......... • moved to Switzerland with mother and stepfather, has lived there ever since.
   C Later Life: • became European Champion for players under 18 in ......... • won the Wimbledon doubles title in ......... at the age of 15. • won all four Grand Slam doubles titles in .........
   D Jadval: CHARACTER: determined, hardworking, keen on all sports | LIKES: horse riding, skiing, going to ........., art galleries, theatre, cinema | PLANS: When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep ......... .

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '53'.

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Jamoalarda quyidagi so'z va iboralardan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap bir ochko oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
7-UNIT LUG'ATINI TAKRORLASh.

  ⚠ Hamma ibora 48-52-betlarda
  uchragan: Dianne Grey (48-49) va
  Bill Gates (52) matnlaridan.

modelSentences.sentence: Dianne has been training local people as health care workers.
modelSentences.uz: Dianne mahalliy aholini tibbiyot xodimi sifatida o'qitib kelmoqda.  (mahalliy aholini o'qitmoq)

modelSentences.sentence: She has treated thousands of patients in Angola.
modelSentences.uz: U Angolada minglab bemorni davoladi.  (bemorlarni davolamoq)

modelSentences.sentence: The organisation sends medical equipment to Africa.
modelSentences.uz: Tashkilot Afrikaga tibbiy jihozlar yuboradi.  (tibbiy jihozlar)

modelSentences.sentence: She has been working hard to improve conditions there.
modelSentences.uz: U u yerdagi sharoitni yaxshilash uchun qattiq ishlab kelmoqda.  (sharoitni yaxshilamoq)

modelSentences.sentence: She has never felt so useful before.
modelSentences.uz: U hech qachon o'zini bunchalik foydali his qilmagan.  (foydali his qilmoq)

modelSentences.sentence: Standards of health care have grown worse in Angola.
modelSentences.uz: Angolada tibbiy xizmat darajasi yomonlashgan.  (tibbiy xizmat)

modelSentences.sentence: Dianne had a good career ahead of her.
modelSentences.uz: Dianning oldida yaxshi karyera bor edi.  (yaxshi karyera)

modelSentences.sentence: Before long, Microsoft was a major business success.
modelSentences.uz: Ko'p o'tmay Microsoft katta biznes muvaffaqiyatiga aylandi.  (biznes muvaffaqiyati)

modelSentences.sentence: Gates plans to give away his wealth when he retires.
modelSentences.uz: Gates nafaqaga chiqqanida boyligini berib yuborishni rejalashtiryapti.  (nafaqaga chiqmoq)

modelSentences.sentence: Since then, the company has continued to grow.
modelSentences.uz: O'shandan beri kompaniya o'sishda davom etmoqda.  (o'sishda davom etmoq)

modelSentences.sentence: His work hasn't left him much time for a normal personal life.
modelSentences.uz: Ishi unga oddiy shaxsiy hayot uchun ko'p vaqt qoldirmagan.  (oddiy shaxsiy hayot)

modelSentences.sentence: Bill Gates started a business with a friend in 1975.
modelSentences.uz: Bill Gates 1975 yilda do'sti bilan biznes boshladi.  (biznes boshlamoq)

modelSentences.sentence: He has given huge amounts of money to charity.
modelSentences.uz: U xayriyaga katta miqdorda pul bergan.  (katta miqdorda pul)

modelSentences.sentence: He plans to give away almost all of his wealth.
modelSentences.uz: U deyarli butun boyligini berib yuborishni rejalashtiryapti.  (boylik)

modelSentences.sentence: Bill has mixed feelings about running Microsoft.
modelSentences.uz: Bill Microsoftni boshqarish haqida aralash his-tuyg'ularga ega.  (aralash his-tuyg'ular)

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick the words which end with the sound /ɪd/. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va /ɪd/ tovushi bilan tugaydigan so'zlarni belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'-ED' QO'ShIMChASINING UCh TALAFFUZI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  /ɪd/ - fe'l /t/ yoki /d/ bilan
     tugasa:
     wantED, treatED, decidED,
     succeedED, startED, needED
     ⚠ Alohida BO'G'IN qo'shiladi!

  /t/ - fe'l JARANGSIZ undosh bilan
     tugasa (k, p, s, sh, ch, f):
     likED, workED, helpED, walkED,
     stoppED, watchED

  /d/ - fe'l JARANGLI undosh yoki
     UNLI bilan tugasa:
     livED, playED, openED, callED


JAVOBLAR (/ɪd/ bilan):

  ✓ wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/
  ✓ treated /ˈtriːtɪd/
  ✓ decided /dɪˈsaɪdɪd/
  ✓ succeeded /səkˈsiːdɪd/

  ✗ liked /laɪkt/
  ✗ lived /lɪvd/
  ✗ worked /wɜːkt/
  ✗ helped /helpt/
  ✗ walked /wɔːkt/


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:

  'liked' ni 'lay-ked' deb ikki
  bo'g'in qilib aytish - XATO!
  Faqat /t/ yoki /d/ dan keyin
  alohida bo'g'in bo'ladi.


⚠ 'TO SUCCEED':

  = muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.
  ⚠ 'success' (ot), 'successful'
  (sifat).

sections.title: Writing (a profile of a famous person)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a profile of a famous person we usually divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Mashhur odam profilini yozganda uni odatda to'rt xatboshiga bo'lamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
PROFIL YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'RT XATBOShI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) KIRISh - kim va nima uchun
     muhim
     'Everyone has heard of ...'

  2) BOLALIK - qachon/qayerda
     tug'ilgan, bolalik, maktab
     'He was born on ... in ...'

  3) KEYINGI HAYOT - karyera, muhim
     voqealar XRONOLOGIK tartibda
     'In 1975 ... Since then ...'

  4) XARAKTER, YoQTIRGAN NARSALAR,
     REJALAR
     'He is ambitious ... He likes
      ... He plans to ...'


⚠ 'CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER':

  = xronologik tartib (vaqt bo'yicha,
  eskidan yangiga).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˌkrɒnəˈlɒdʒɪkl/ -
  'ch' → /k/.


⚠ 'TO ATTEND':

  = qatnashmoq, o'qimoq (maktabda).
  ⚠ 'the school he attended' =
  u o'qigan maktab.
  ⚠ 'attend TO' - XATO (predlogsiz).


⚠ 'CHILDHOOD':

  = bolalik.
  ⚠ 'child' + '-hood'.


⚠ 52-BETDAGI BILL GATES MATNI -
  AYNI ShU TUZILISh (22a mashqda
  sarlavhalar moslangan edi).

points.en: In the first paragraph, we write who the person is and why he/she is important.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida odam kim ekani va nima uchun muhimligini yozamiz.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we write about the person's early life (i.e. when and where he/she was born, his/her childhood, the school he/she attended, etc.).
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida odamning bolaligi haqida yozamiz (ya'ni qachon va qayerda tug'ilgani, bolaligi, o'qigan maktabi va h.k.).

points.en: In the third paragraph, we write about the person's later life, (i.e. his/her career and important events in his/her life, in chronological order).
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida odamning keyingi hayoti haqida yozamiz (ya'ni karyerasi va hayotidagi muhim voqealar, xronologik tartibda).

points.en: In the last paragraph, we write about the person's character, likes and plans.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida odamning xarakteri, yoqtirgan narsalari va rejalari haqida yozamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and complete the notes, then talk about Martina.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va qaydlarni to'ldiring, so'ng Martina haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MARTINA HINGIS - TENNISChI.

  ⚠ AUDIO KERAK - bo'sh joylar
  yozuvdan to'ldiriladi. Umumiy
  ma'lum faktlar (tug'ilgan yili,
  Wimbledon yili) qo'shilgan; qolgani
  audio bilan tekshirilsin.


QAYDLAR:

  A INTRODUCTION:
    • Martina Hingis
    • one of the greatest tennis
      players in the history of
      women's tennis

  B EARLY LIFE:
    • born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia,
      on 30th September, 1980
    • started playing tennis at the
      age of three
    • parents divorced, her mother
      remarried in ......
    • moved to Switzerland with
      mother and stepfather, has
      lived there ever since

  C LATER LIFE:
    • became European Champion for
      players under 18 in ......
    • won the Wimbledon doubles title
      in 1996 at the age of 15
    • won all four Grand Slam doubles
      titles in 1998

  D CHARACTER: determined,
      hardworking, keen on all sports
    LIKES: horse riding, skiing,
      going to ......, art galleries,
      theatre, cinema
    PLANS: When she retires from
      tennis, she'd like to keep
      ......


⚠ 'CZECHOSLOVAKIA':

  Chexoslovakiya - 1993 gacha bo'lgan
  davlat (hozir Chexiya va
  Slovakiya). Kosice hozir
  Slovakiyada.


⚠ 'TO DIVORCE' / 'TO REMARRY':

  divorce = ajrashmoq
  remarry = qayta turmushga chiqmoq
  ⚠ 'a stepfather' = o'gay ota.


⚠ 'EVER SINCE':

  = o'shandan beri (hozirgacha).
  ⚠ 'has lived there EVER SINCE' -
  present perfect.


⚠ 'DOUBLES':

  = juftlik o'yini (tennis).
  ⚠ 'singles' = yakka o'yin.


⚠ 'GRAND SLAM':

  Tennisdagi to'rt eng katta turnir:
  Australian Open, French Open,
  Wimbledon, US Open.


⚠ 'DETERMINED':

  = qat'iyatli.


⚠ 'KEEN ON':

  = ... ga qiziqadigan, ishqiboz.
  ⚠ 'keen ON' - 'on' predlogi.

items.textEn: B: born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia, on 30th September, ___
items.whyUz:
⚠ Martina Hingis 1980 yil 30-sentyabrda
tug'ilgan.
⚠ Audio bilan tekshiring.

items.textEn: C: won the Wimbledon doubles title in ___ at the age of 15
items.whyUz:
⚠ 1996 yil Wimbledon juftlik chempioni -
15 yoshida (eng yosh).
⚠ Audio bilan tekshiring.

items.textEn: C: won all four Grand Slam doubles titles in ___
items.whyUz:
⚠ 1998 yilda to'rttala Grand Slam juftlik
unvonini yutgan.
⚠ Audio bilan tekshiring.

audiodan to'ldiriladi:

exercises.instructionEn: Your teacher has asked you to write a profile of a famous sportsperson for the school magazine. Use the plan below, the information in Ex. 27, and the picture in the Photo File section, to write a profile of Martina Hingis (120 - 180 words). Use the text in Ex. 22 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: O'qituvchingiz maktab jurnali uchun mashhur sportchi profilini yozishni so'radi. Quyidagi reja, 27-mashqdagi ma'lumot va Photo File bo'limidagi suratdan foydalanib Martina Hingis profilini yozing (120-180 so'z). 22-mashqdagi matndan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
REJA (daftardagi):

  Introduction
    Para 1: introduce the person
  Main Body
    Para 2: early life
    Para 3: later life
  Conclusion
    Para 4: character, likes, plans


⚠ 52-BETDAGI BILL GATES MATNI -
  NAMUNA. So'zlarni Martina
  ma'lumotlariga almashtiring.


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  Kirish: present perfect / present
    simple ('Everyone has heard of',
    'is one of the greatest')
  Bolalik va keyingi hayot: PAST
    SIMPLE ('was born', 'started',
    'won')
  'ever since' bilan: present
    perfect ('has lived there ever
    since')
  Xarakter: present simple
  Rejalar: "she'd like to"


⚠ 'A SPORTSPERSON':

  = sportchi (jinsga betaraf).
  ⚠ 'sportsman' / 'sportswoman' ham
  bor.


⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB audiosiz bo'sh joylar
  bilan yozilgan - audiodan keyin
  to'ldiring.

structure.exampleEn: Everyone has heard of Martina Hingis, one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis.

structure.hintUz: tug'ilgan joy/sana, tennis boshlash, Shveytsariyaga ko'chish
structure.exampleEn: She was born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia, on 30th September, 1980. She started playing tennis at the age of three. Her parents divorced and her mother remarried. Martina moved to Switzerland with her mother and stepfather, and she has lived there ever since.

structure.hintUz: Yevropa chempioni, Wimbledon, Grand Slam - xronologik
structure.exampleEn: She became European Champion for players under 18. In 1996, at the age of 15, she won the Wimbledon doubles title. In 1998 she won all four Grand Slam doubles titles.

structure.hintUz: determined, hardworking; horse riding, skiing; retire plans
structure.exampleEn: Martina is determined and hardworking, and she is keen on all sports. She likes horse riding, skiing and going to art galleries, the theatre and the cinema. When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.

modelAnswers: Everyone has heard of Martina Hingis, one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis.

She was born in Kosice, Czechoslovakia, on 30th September, 1980. She started playing tennis at the age of three. Her parents divorced and her mother remarried. Martina moved to Switzerland with her mother and stepfather, and she has lived there ever since.
She became European Champion for players under 18. In 1996, at the age of 15, she won the Wimbledon doubles title. In 1998 she won all four Grand Slam doubles titles.

Martina is determined and hardworking, and she is keen on all sports. She likes horse riding, skiing and going to art galleries, the theatre and the cinema. When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.
modelAnswersUz: Martina Hingis haqida hamma eshitgan - u ayollar tennisi tarixidagi eng buyuk o'yinchilardan biri.

U 1980 yil 30-sentyabrda Chexoslovakiyaning Kosice shahrida tug'ilgan. Uch yoshida tennis o'ynay boshlagan. Ota-onasi ajrashgan va onasi qayta turmushga chiqqan. Martina onasi va o'gay otasi bilan Shveytsariyaga ko'chgan va o'shandan beri u yerda yashaydi.
U 18 yoshgacha o'yinchilar orasida Yevropa chempioni bo'ldi. 1996 yilda, 15 yoshida, Wimbledon juftlik unvonini yutdi. 1998 yilda to'rttala Grand Slam juftlik unvonini yutdi.
Martina qat'iyatli va mehnatkash, barcha sport turlariga ishqiboz. U ot minish, chang'i uchish, san'at galereyalari, teatr va kinoga borishni yoqtiradi. Tennisdan ketganida ot boqishni xohlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL - TAJRIBA VA TAQDIR
HAQIDA.

⚠ 'AN ARCHITECT':
  = me'mor.
  ⚠ 'ch' → /k/: /ˈɑːkɪtekt/.

⚠ 'FORTUNE':
  = taqdir; boylik.
  ⚠ 'fortunate' = omadli.

⚠ 'EVERY MAN':
  Eski maqolda 'man' = odam (hamma).

items.answerEn: It means that we learn more from doing things ourselves than from being told about them.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni biror narsani o'zimiz qilib ko'rganda, aytib berilganidan ko'ra ko'proq o'rganamiz.

items.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune.
items.answerEn: It means that your success or failure depends on your own actions and choices.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni muvaffaqiyat yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik o'z harakat va tanlovlaringizga bog'liq. (O'zbekchada: 'Har kim o'z baxtining ustasi'.)

patterns.formula: Everyone has heard of [kim], one of the greatest [kim] in [soha].
patterns.exampleEn: Everyone has heard of Martina Hingis, one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis.
patterns.exampleUz: Martina Hingis haqida hamma eshitgan - ayollar tennisi tarixidagi eng buyuk o'yinchilardan biri.

patterns.exampleEn: She started playing tennis at the age of three.
patterns.exampleUz: U uch yoshida tennis o'ynay boshlagan.

patterns.formula: [Kim] moved to [joy] and has lived there ever since.
patterns.exampleEn: She moved to Switzerland and has lived there ever since.
patterns.exampleUz: U Shveytsariyaga ko'chgan va o'shandan beri u yerda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE (moved) + PRESENT PERFECT (has lived
ever since).

patterns.exampleEn: When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.
